configurations.name: Run Desktop App (Tauri Dev)
configurations.command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && bun run tauri dev

configurations.name: Run Website Dev Server (Astro)
configurations.command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && bun run dev -- --open

configurations.name: Compile & Flash Firmware 4.0 (Teensy)
configurations.command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && arduino-cli compile && arduino-cli upload

configurations.name: Run Real-Camera V2 Hardware Tests
configurations.command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && uv run --with pyserial --with pytest pytest test_v2_*.py
